Overview

Reduction: PCA → 8 Leakage audit: PASSED Test rows: 1800 Best model: CNN+LSTM

Finding. The classical CNN+LSTM outperforms the best quantum model (QSVM) by 3.02 F1 points. The quantum model's ROC-AUC is 0.0012 higher (0.9903 vs 0.9891). McNemar p = 2.389e-06. The quantum models did not provide an advantage on the primary common test under this experimental design.
